review_type: independent semantic adjudication against frozen fictional corpus

review_boundaries.note: Read frozen sources/answers and sealed baseline output/log artifacts only. Logs were used for integrity/procedure context, not implementation diagnosis. This audit precedes access to any improved run.

method: Required meaning is assessed across selected title, exact excerpt, extraction rationale and packet gaps, not exact quote fragments alone.
A record kind/status is accepted when the prose preserves authority, uncertainty and chronology.
allowed_for is a strong relevance guide, not a substitute for semantic judgment; qualified useful extras and mixed records are assessed individually.
Confirmed wrong selections are request-specific relevance errors, distinct from false source claims. No required item was displaced at the max_items limit.
Coverage counts are fact-request pairs, not independent facts or proof of future-corpus performance.

summary.conclusion: Complete required semantic coverage; two off-task QA research additions and one misleading QA missing-context warning. Numerous exact-label/split-fact mismatches are waived.

waived_flags.reason: observed describes finding promotional wording. Title, quote, and rationale explicitly deny direct execution and knowledge of three features, as allowed by the author notes.

Local-first saving and missing-input validation are both in r13; timestamp preservation/location permission are both in r14. Separate record counts or narrow phrase matches would create false omissions.
risk/open accurately represents an unresolved, unverified risk; title explicitly distinguishes design intent from unperformed crash testing.
question/open plus task/planned preserves unresolved wording and the future proposal commitment. The planned task is not a falsely completed implementation.
Observed server outcome, observed UI defect, and open defect status can be separate. All three remain faithful and are not three independent wrong records.

draft is less precise than planned, but title/rationale/excerpt explicitly preserve the next-run plan and unexecuted state. Waive a semantic status error while separately flagging the generated false gap.
The absence of iOS results is explicit in r26 evidence and gaps[4]; r31 supplies unknown device availability. Restricting matching to r31 title would create a false omission.

open questions about proposed research are defensible alternatives to draft tasks; text does not present them as completed research or approved feature work. This does not excuse unrelated QA selection.

r01/r02/r12 are not selected in any packet. r11 and gaps explain supersession/exclusions without reviving old policy. r01 decision/draft is awkward but explicitly unapproved, and causes no packet error.

Although outside frozen research allowed_for lists, these same-feature state-display mechanisms, unverified crash behavior, unresolved copy, and demonstrated UI defect can inform research on expectations and state communication. They are accurate, qualified, and displace no required facts; do not mechanically count as wrong selections.
The state-communication comparison proposal is relevant design context. Adjacent user-count/price uncertainty is ancillary; that clause does not make the whole record wrong.

ambiguous_flags.issue: iOS device availability is peripheral to field/market research. It can delimit existing evidence and future platform investigation, but selecting it separately is weak prioritization. No confirmed irrelevant record is counted.

Price/user-count discovery is outside functional QA, while comparing local/server status communication could support an exploratory usability check. The combined record is mixed; do not count the entire record as definitely wrong.

The repeated unresolved-passage bookkeeping is verbose and may suggest residual uncertainty, but it explicitly says the old rule was superseded via b04/r11/r12. Count no policy reversal or missing current rule.

gaps[4] says only Android normal-reopen and permission-denied saving were observed, which is locally too narrow. The immediately following gap and selected retry records explicitly disclose the retry observation, so the packet as a whole is not adjudicated as concealing it.
